mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 7.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Unemployment rate at 7.4% as of t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 850) and GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 0.5%) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 850 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) combined with persistently low policy rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) signals delayed monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rate hike expectations materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% annualized) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 98.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 850) and retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < 0.3%) signals deteriorating consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 850 and RSAFS growth rate < 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) creates a 'wait for tightening' regime where delayed Fed action triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation, low policy rates (60-day horizon)
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.
